config_notes: DEPLOYED CONFIGURATION as of 2026-09-30: acceptance-normalised per-event mixture at CT v80 >= 0.30 (= scenario_8_full_pipeline_acc_t030 of json/eight_scenarios_v63_acceptance.json). See docs/pipeline_fixes_2026-09.md, section 'Acceptance term deployed', for the model, the files and the validation. The ES table (analysis.pdf_path / mixture.pdf_es_path), the acceptance (acceptance_path) and the CT threshold are properties of ONE selection and must always move together; the purity calibration and pi_fixed are threshold independent. The previous cut-based configuration (CT v80 >= 0.80, predicted-es, emcee) is scenario_3_full_pipeline of the same catalog. NOTE: python/app/pipeline.py (= scripts/run_pipeline.py) runs only selection, CT and ED; the burst fit is python/ana/scenario_cos_theta_report.py, which reads the 'reporting' block of <scenario_dir>/config.json (test/run_small_sample_pipeline.sh writes it from the catalog entry and overwrites the 'reporting' block below).

input_data._note: 3-plane mode: matches clusters across X/U/V using match_id (metadata column 13). Folders are a generic example (cat000001); test/run_small_sample_pipeline.sh replaces them per CAT (PRODUCT_SUFFIX selects e.g. the _matchfix products). The *_bg_matched_* patterns are the ones every scenario run uses.

sample_selection.description: Full burst sample: 330 ES + 3300 CC generated events (the budget of every campaign; TEST_N_ES / TEST_N_CC in the scenario runner)

channel_tagger.description: Channel tagging CNN v80 (ES vs CC). Deployed hard cut CT score >= 0.30 (plateau 0.25-0.35 of the threshold scan). The scenario runner uses this model_path unless CT_MODEL is set.

electron_direction.description: ED v63 (v58 weights fine-tuned on the matcher-fixed ES production pool); writes predictions/reco_directions.npz aligned with volume_images/volumes.npz

volume_creation.description: Use simple mode unless online-pointing-utils is set and available

analysis.description: Burst direction fit. selection_mode mixture-ct is fitted by the exact grid mixture posterior (grid_n directions), NOT by emcee: the emcee path is the weighted pseudo-likelihood and cannot express the per-event mixture. The emcee block is used only by non-mixture scenarios (predicted-es / true-es / weighted-ct, e.g. catalog scenario 3) and supplies random_seed to the grid fit; uniform prior with grid-seeded walkers (init_mode grid is also the code default).

reporting.label: Full pipeline + acceptance t=0.30 [DEPLOYED DEFAULT] (CT v80>=0.30, E>5MeV, grid mixture)
reporting.description: What python/ana/scenario_cos_theta_report.py actually reads (from <scenario_dir>/config.json). Same content as the analysis block, in the layout test/run_small_sample_pipeline.sh writes for scenario_8_full_pipeline_acc_t030, so a single run placed in <root>/scenario_<name>/ can be fitted with the report script directly.
